summary: A household that supports the other side tells the canvasser to take them off the list.
realLife: A volunteer in northern Virginia met a household that said to take her off the list.
sources: Daily Kos, Tales from the Field: Hitting the Doors in NOVA, 2021-10-31: https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2021/10/31/2061272/-Tales-from-the-Field-Hitting-the-Doors-in-NOVA
inGame: household leaning against the player on the views record; the list entry marked do not contact

turns.turn: The household is removed from further contact
turns.pulledBy: an opposing lean on the household
turns.writesBack: the list entry is struck, no second knock

turns.turn: The resident says it and then asks a question about the candidate
turns.writesBack: the canvasser answers once and thanks them
